	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_mass_conscription value = approve } } add = 1 }

sg_law_politics_law_mass_conscription = {

	}
	multiply = 25
}

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sg_law_available_law_national_supremacy = yes }
		add = { value = sg_law_merit_law_national_supremacy }
		add = { value = sg_law_enactment_chance_law_national_supremacy multiply = 2 }
		add = sg_law_politics_law_national_supremacy
	}
	min = -100
	max = 450
}

	if = { limit = { radical_fraction = { value >= 0.2 } } add = 8 }
	if = { limit = { sg_law_powerful_opposition_law_secret_police > 0 } add = 12 }
	min = 0
	max = 60
}

sg_bpm_stance_law_secret_police = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_secret_police value = strongly_approve } } add = 2 }
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_secret_police value = approve } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_secret_police value = disapprove } } add = -1 }
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_secret_police value = strongly_disapprove } } add = -2 }
}
sg_law_politics_law_secret_police = {
	value = 0
	every_interest_group = {
		limit = { bpm_ig_is_marginal = no }
		add = { value = sg_bpm_stance_law_secret_police subtract = sg_bpm_current_stance_lawgroup_internal_security multiply = ig_clout }
	}
	multiply = 25
}

sg_law_enactment_chance_law_secret_police = {
	value = "enactment_chance_for_law(law_type:law_secret_police)"
	multiply = 100
	min = 0
	max = 100
}

sg_law_merit_law_secret_police = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sg_law_benefit_law_secret_police }
	subtract = { value = sg_law_risk_law_secret_police multiply = 0.5 }
	min = -100
	max = 150
}

sg_law_score_law_secret_police = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sg_law_available_law_secret_police = yes }
		add = { value = sg_law_merit_law_secret_police }
		add = { value = sg_law_enactment_chance_law_secret_police multiply = 2 }
		add = sg_law_politics_law_secret_police
	}
	min = -100
	max = 450
}

	multiply = 100
	min = 0
	max = 100
}

sg_law_merit_law_party_single = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sg_law_benefit_law_party_single }
	subtract = { value = sg_law_risk_law_party_single multiply = 0.5 }
	min = -100
	max = 150
}

sg_law_score_law_party_single = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sg_law_available_law_party_single = yes }
		add = { value = sg_law_merit_law_party_single }
		add = { value = sg_law_enactment_chance_law_party_single multiply = 2 }
		add = sg_law_politics_law_party_single
	}
	min = -100
	max = 450
}

sg_law_benefit_law_party_socialist_only = {
	value = 30.0
	min = 0
	max = 100
}

sg_law_powerful_opposition_law_party_socialist_only = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_interest_group = {
				is_powerful = yes
				law_stance = { law = law_type:law_party_socialist_only value <= strongly_disapprove }
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

sg_law_risk_law_party_socialist_only = {
	value = 5.0
	if = { limit = { sg_law_powerful_opposition_law_party_socialist_only > 0 } add = 12 }
	min = 0
	max = 60
}

sg_bpm_stance_law_party_socialist_only = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_party_socialist_only value = strongly_approve } } add = 2 }
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_party_socialist_only value = approve } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_party_socialist_only value = disapprove } } add = -1 }
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_party_socialist_only value = strongly_disapprove } } add = -2 }
}
sg_law_politics_law_party_socialist_only = {
	value = 0
	every_interest_group = {
		limit = { bpm_ig_is_marginal = no }
		add = { value = sg_bpm_stance_law_party_socialist_only subtract = sg_bpm_current_stance_lawgroup_party_laws multiply = ig_clout }
	}
	multiply = 25
}

sg_law_enactment_chance_law_party_socialist_only = {
	value = "enactment_chance_for_law(law_type:law_party_socialist_only)"
	multiply = 100

	if = { limit = { sg_law_powerful_opposition_law_women_in_the_workplace > 0 } add = 12 }
	min = 0
	max = 60
}

sg_bpm_stance_law_women_in_the_workplace = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_in_the_workplace value = strongly_approve } } add = 2 }
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_in_the_workplace value = approve } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_in_the_workplace value = disapprove } } add = -1 }
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_women_in_the_workplace value = strongly_disapprove } } add = -2 }
}
sg_law_politics_law_women_in_the_workplace = {
	value = 0
	every_interest_group = {
		limit = { bpm_ig_is_marginal = no }
		add = { value = sg_bpm_stance_law_women_in_the_workplace subtract = sg_bpm_current_stance_lawgroup_rights_of_women multiply = ig_clout }
	}
	multiply = 25
}

sg_law_enactment_chance_law_women_in_the_workplace = {
	value = "enactment_chance_for_law(law_type:law_women_in_the_workplace)"
	multiply = 100
	min = 0
	max = 100
}

sg_law_merit_law_women_in_the_workplace = {
	value = 0
	add = { value = sg_law_benefit_law_women_in_the_workplace }
	subtract = { value = sg_law_risk_law_women_in_the_workplace multiply = 0.5 }
	min = -100
	max = 150
}

sg_law_score_law_women_in_the_workplace = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { sg_law_available_law_women_in_the_workplace = yes }
		add = { value = sg_law_merit_law_women_in_the_workplace }
		add = { value = sg_law_enactment_chance_law_women_in_the_workplace multiply = 2 }
		add = sg_law_politics_law_women_in_the_workplace
	}
	min = -100
	max = 450
}

	min = 0
	max = 60

sg_bpm_stance_law_unregulated_work_time = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_unregulated_work_time value = strongly_approve } } add = 2 }
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_unregulated_work_time value = approve } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_unregulated_work_time value = disapprove } } add = -1 }
	if = { limit = { law_stance = { law = law_type:law_unregulated_work_time value = strongly_disapprove } } add = -2 }
}

	value = 0
	every_interest_group = {
		limit = { bpm_ig_is_marginal = no }
		add = { value = sg_bpm_stance_law_unregulated_work_time subtract = sg_bpm_current_stance_lawgroup_work_time_regulations multiply = ig_clout }
	}
	multiply = 25
}
